# Generated by the iData query agent. Requires the reticulate package and the IMF-managed Python
# with imf_datatools installed (see "Using datatools with R" in the datatools documentation).
library(reticulate)
use_python("C:/ProgramData/Python3", required = TRUE)
Sys.setenv(TZ = "UTC")   # reticulate shifts datetimes to local time otherwise

imf_datatools <- import("imf_datatools")
imf_datatools$$idata_utilities$$PRIVATE <- TRUE   # required for internal databases

db  <- '$database'
# Key order for this database: $key_order
$dimension_lines
key <- '$key'

df <- imf_datatools$$get_idata_data(db, key, start = '$start', end = '$end', longformat = $longformat)

$save_line
